title: Two-Terminal Perovskite/Cu(In,Ga)Se2 Tandems with Conformal Coatings Based on Commercial Bottom Cells with >26% Efficiency
content:

Cong Geng, Kuanxiang Zhang, Jiwen Jiang, Changhua Wang, Chung Hsien Wu, Jize Wang, Fei Long, Liyuan Han, Yi-Bing Cheng, Yong Peng
